scope: Repeated PPML storage capacities, actual owner/lifetime totals and optional reuse admission; no memory policy, IRLS or solver change.

owners.storage: One four-field contribution: resident, I/O and disk bytes plus projection RHS count. Fast original allocation capacity survives compaction; Low pool resident storage and file capacity stay separate.
owners.prepared_model: Canonical numeric, FE topology, cluster topology and prepared metadata payload reused by current generation, replacement generation and common phases. Row ledgers, row allowance, staging and retained probability/offset capacity remain separate.
owners.numerical_detector: Linear projection, detector vectors and certificate form one shared total. Proposal, exact-level transient and simplex maxima remain separate. Mu adds retained mean to its numerical detector/cascade/transaction only.
owners.final_results: Fitted state, final drop reasons, separation reports and inference result survive into inference, recovery and publication. Each phase adds its own transient work.
owners.optional_reuse: One checked peak predicate with caller-supplied other two buffers and proposed replacement; addition order and mutation after success unchanged.

evaluation_boundary: Common owner totals computed once per route and reused across its generation/phase sums. Fast then Low evaluation remains separate to preserve failure precedence. No large cached common record, default-zero inventory or duplicate memory model.

complexity.interpretation: Real accounting duplication removed, modest net reduction after counting helpers; the inherited calculation remains large.

scalar_characterization.axes: N1/17/16383/65536/100000; K0/1/5/16/65; FE0/1/2/3; threads1/4/16; slopes, retained capacities, separation/Mu/rebase/exact/singletons, outputs, audit and bias metadata varied. Fast/Low/Auto × unknown/tiny/768MiB budget; invalid and u128 overflow edges.
